text:
Maya (marketing): Quick heads-up — we have a clash on analyst briefings on Apr 15. EU slot overlaps with APAC coverage requests, need to swap slots and confirm quote owners + a fallback pre-approved quote. Can folks weigh in? :thinking:
AJ - comms: Which exact slots? can you drop calendar links?
Maya (marketing): Current slots:
```
- EU Analyst: 2026-04-15 11:00 UTC (Sam)
- APAC Analyst: 2026-04-15 20:00 JST (Priya)
```
Proposed swap so one senior PR owns both windows (fewer handoffs):
```
- EU -> 2026-04-15 13:00 UTC (Sam)
- APAC -> 2026-04-15 09:00 JST (Sam covers APAC)
```
Sam (PR): I can cover APAC only if legal signs the quote by EOD PST. otherwise I should stay on EU only. calendar: https://calendar.redwood.com/briefs/Apr15
Olivia (legal): I have the draft, reviewing now. I can fast-track a short approved line by 17:30 PST — ping me if it hits heavier legal language.
Dante (growth): If legal might slip, please put a lightweight fallback quote in the brief pack so analysts don't stall. something non-committal like: "We’re excited to share early performance signals from our new inference pipeline; we’ll publish detailed benchmarks after rollout."
Maya (marketing): Good call. Olivia — can you approve that exact fallback snippet or tweak?
Olivia (legal): That fallback line is fine. I’ll also add a one-sentence clarifier to the fact-check doc so we don’t accidentally leak roadmap-level claims. link: https://redwood.internal/press/factcheck-apr15
Sam (PR): OK locking in: I’ll move EU to 13:00 UTC and claim APAC 09:00 JST only if legal timestamp clears. I’ll cc the analysts and drop the brief pack and a single-slide quote summary.
Maya (marketing): One more ask — embargo needs to be explicit for cross-region pickup. Recommend changing embargo to 2026-04-16 14:00 UTC so APAC has morning local pickup. Thoughts?
AJ - comms: Agree on the later universal embargo; less chance of early APAC pickup. That means timing in PR materials + analyst invites need updated embargo line.
Sam (PR): I’ll update invites and the press kit. drafting email now — will include a short "if legal delayed" contingency with the fallback quote.
pressbot: Embargo updated to 2026-04-16T14:00:00Z by Sam (PR) :white_check_mark:
Maya (marketing): Thanks team. Action items:
- Sam: update calendar invites + send brief pack (includes fallback quote) — due: now + 1h
- Olivia: finalize and confirm quote text — due: 17:30 PST
- AJ: update embargo line in press kit + confirm with distribution list
- Dante: prep a 1-slide summary for analysts with QoE/latency highlights (non-sensitive)
If anyone sees a timezone issue with the proposed swap call it out now. Otherwise I’ll mark this resolved in 1h and start the dry-run for quotes. :thumbsup:
